text: Blueprint visual scripting lets designers use engine tools normally only available to programmers
quote: provides the ability for designers to use virtually the full range of concepts and tools generally only available to programmers

text: Create new C++ gameplay classes; changes appear in editor after recompiling
quote: Creating new Gameplay classes in C++, and all changes will be reflected in the Unreal Editor after compiling with either Visual Studio or XCode.

text: Dynamically bind a delegate to a member function of an arbitrary object at runtime
quote: You can dynamically bind a delegate to a member function of an arbitrary object, calling the function on the object at a future time

text: Automate time-consuming asset management tasks like generating LODs for static meshes
quote: Automate time-consuming Asset management tasks in the Unreal Editor, like generating Levels of Detail (LODs) for Static Meshes.

text: Plugins add runtime gameplay features, modify engine behavior, and extend the editor; can be toggled per-project
quote: Plugins can add runtime gameplay functionality, modify built-in Engine features (or add new ones), create new file types, and extend the capabilities of the Editor

text: Asset Manager lets you divide content into chunks and precisely control asset discovery, loading, and auditing
quote: provides a framework for managing Assets that can divide content into chunks that make sense in the context of your project

text: Command-line arguments/launch parameters customize engine startup for testing and optimizing projects
quote: command-line arguments can be an invaluable tool for testing and optimizing your project

text: Replication synchronizes data and function calls between game clients and servers
quote: Replication is the name for the process of synchronizing data and procedure calls between clients and servers

text: UE Toolbar lets you quickly test part of the currently loaded level for debugging
quote: Use UE Toolbar to quickly test a part of your currently loaded Level for testing and debugging.

text: Full access to engine source code across all platforms and features
quote: Access to the source code

text: Command-line cook command packages content, deploys to a device, and runs the project automatically for a target platform
quote: UnrealEditor.exe <GameName or uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=<Plat1>+<Plat2>

text: Cook command supports specifying multiple target platforms and maps for headless packaging
quote: This command can cook content for a platform, package it up into a platform's native format for distribution, deploys it to the device, and automatically runs the project

text: Remote Control system runs a web server inside Unreal Engine servicing WebSocket and HTTP requests via a REST-like API
quote: The Remote Control system makes this possible by running a web server inside the Unreal Engine that services WebSocket messages and HTTP requests made by remote web applications through a REST-like API.

text: Operate the Unreal Editor remotely from another computer or mobile device on the same network
quote: You can operate the Engine remotely, from a different computer or mobile device that is connected to the same network as the computer running Unreal.

text: Remotely call any function callable from Blueprint, including BlueprintCallable C++ functions
quote: You can call any function that is callable from Blueprint. This includes any function defined in C++ with the BlueprintCallable specifier, or any function that is defined and implemented entirely in Blueprint.

text: Call an HTTP route through a WebSocket message for remote control
quote: Use this message type to call an HTTP route through a WebSocket message.

text: Automate or randomize actor placement/layout and build custom asset import/management pipelines
quote: Minimize or eliminate the need to repeat the same series of tasks over and over, Automate or randomize the placement, layout and settings of Actors in your Levels, Create your own Asset import and management pipelines

text: Choose to build a monolithic executable via BuildConfiguration.cs settings
quote: You can choose to build a monolithic executable in the BuildConfiguration.cs file.

text: Build larger-scale asset pipelines connecting the Unreal Editor to other 3D applications in a studio
quote: Construct larger-scale asset management pipelines or workflows that tie the Unreal Editor to other 3D applications that you use in your organization.

text: Control the Unreal Editor from custom UIs built in Python
quote: Control the Unreal Editor from UIs that you create yourself in Python.

text: Unreal Automation Tool automates processes including testing and building games headlessly
quote: Unreal Automation Tool is a generic system used to automate processes, including testing and building games.

text: Cooking converts content from internal engine format into platform-specific format for each target
quote: The process of converting content from the internal format to the platform-specific format is referred to as cooking.

text: Unreal Reflection System with Metadata Property Specifier macros exposes classes to editor functionality
quote: Using the Unreal Reflection System to encapsulate your classes with Metadata Property Specifier macros that provide Editor functionality

text: Expose project content to the Remote Control API without coding and bind it to widgets in a web app
quote: Without any coding, you can expose Project Content to the Remote Control API through a Remote Control Preset and connect them to widgets in a companion web application.
